response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer (13+ years, BS in CS) with real high-throughput production exposure at Sociomantic/dunnhumby and a strong craftsmanship/testing culture, which satisfies the baseline experience and language requirements. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered specifically on experimentation platforms, telemetry and metrics infrastructure, feature flighting, and statistical decision-making at enterprise scale — and the resume shows no evidence of A/B testing systems, growth engineering, guardrail metrics, bias detection, or data/statistical analysis work. The scope of leadership demonstrated (small-to-midsize companies, individual product teams, open-source projects) also falls short of the multi-workstream, cross-org influence expected at IC6 in a large enterprise. Strong generalist, but a poor match for this specialization.
strengths: 13+ years of broad production experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with a CS degree
Real low-latency, high-volume distributed systems work (millions of HTTP req/s at Sociomantic)
Demonstrated tooling/platform mindset: test runners, libraries, CI/CD, dev-ops, MCP/AI-agent tooling, plus teaching and mentoring
concerns: No experimentation, feature-flagging, or A/B testing platform experience mentioned
No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/experimental analysis background
Leadership scope appears team-level rather than Principal/IC6 cross-org, multi-workstream architecture

key_factors.factor: Insufficient evidence of Principal-level cross-team technical leadership
Deep, long-tenured engineering breadth with high-scale production systems
